announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.2 — Plugin SketchUp 1.10.1: Gambar Kerja kini bisa untuk bangunan (denah per lantai, tampak 4 sisi, potongan & atap skala 1:100), semua lembar lebih mudah dibaca saat dicetak (huruf minimal 2,5 mm, garis tidak menumpuk), dan alat baru Copy Path untuk menyalin objek di sepanjang garis. Plugin diperbarui otomatis saat ARA dibuka. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.2 — SketchUp plugin 1.10.1: Shop Drawings now work for buildings (a floor plan per level, 4 elevations, section & roof at 1:100), every sheet is easier to read when printed (text at least 2.5 mm, no overlapping lines), and a new Copy Path tool to copy objects along a line. The plugin updates automatically when ARA opens. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
